description: Self-correcting text-to-SQL agent: local Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B, sqlglot read-only guard, FastAPI, Spider ablation

release.title: v1.0.0 - self-correcting text-to-SQL agent with Spider ablation
release.notes:
First release.

- `t2s` agent: schema introspection, bge-small schema linking, cross-database few-shot retrieval, Ollama generation, sqlglot safety guard with a read-only sandboxed executor, and a feedback retry loop (up to 2 retries).
- CLI (`python -m t2s ask | eval | serve`) and FastAPI service (`POST /query`, `GET /health`).
- Evaluation on a fixed 200-question Spider 1.0 dev slice (stratified by hardness, seed 42): ablation arms A0-A3 plus A1R and optional 3B arms, Wilson 95% CIs, McNemar tests, retry fix rate, latency and token logging, red-team run, cross-check against the official test-suite evaluator.
- All numbers in the README come from `results/`, measured on a Windows 10 laptop with an RTX 3050 Ti 4 GB.
- pytest suite with a mocked LLM and GitHub Actions (ruff + pytest).
